costIfIgnored: The salon could give services for payments never received, losing deposit income and causing disputes.
fixPrompt: In server.js in the POST /api/bookings/:id/verify handler, check if the submitted reference is already stored on another booking and if so reject it, and add a unique constraint on bookings.paystack_ref so one reference can confirm only one booking.
note: The code does not block reuse of a payment reference for another booking. I checked the verify handler and the bookings table definition.
plain: A customer could pay once and reuse that same payment to confirm a second booking, so the second booking looks paid when no new payment was made.
title: Same payment reference can confirm multiple bookings
